page: Microsoft Azure FX8mds_v2 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the FXmdsv2 family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical Intel Xeon 8573C cores, operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The server is equipped with 168.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 21.0 GB per core. Local storage consists of a bundled 472 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable. Virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Benchmark results indicate strong single-core capabilities, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2361.0 and a single-threaded text processing score of 3002.0, both placing in the top tier. Single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression also show strong performance, reaching 34.97 GB/sec and 14.45 GB/sec respectively. Multi-core and memory bandwidth metrics generally align with average tiers, including a stress-ng multi-core CPU performance of 8890.65 and a Passmark memory score of 2525.3. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth is measured at 66.42 GB/sec.

The server exhibits a performance tradeoff in large-scale parallel tasks; while small-model LLM text generation performs in the top tier at 344.1 tokens/sec, medium-model text generation drops to a weaker tier at 8.5 tokens/sec. Given the high memory density of 21.0 GB per core and dedicated CPU allocation, this configuration is suited for memory-intensive workloads, database operations, and applications requiring high single-thread execution speeds alongside local NVMe storage.
